author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
What happens when the brightest star
dims that which is within?
Knowing your beacon
opens floods
The sharp one,
a trianlge
dividing the two
into broken threes
of past memories
Even Pulpin growls
warnings of
warrior, nimrod, king
the same?
